user.title: Connect to Weaviate and Ollama
user.description:
Enter the connection details for your Weaviate vector database and Ollama instance.

Weaviate URL: [Documentation]({weaviate_url_docs_link})
Ollama URL: [Documentation]({ollama_url_docs_link})

select_model.title: Select Embedding Model
select_model.description: Choose the embedding model to use for generating vector embeddings. Models marked as '(downloaded)' are already available on your Ollama server. Selecting a model not yet downloaded will trigger a download.

download.title: Downloading Model: {embedding_model}
download.description: Please wait while the selected embedding model is downloaded by the Ollama server. This may take several minutes depending on the model size and your internet connection.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Weaviate or Ollama. Please check the URL and ensure the service is running.
error.invalid_response: Ollama API returned an invalid response.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Queen's Guard is allowed.
abort.download_failed: Failed to download the selected embedding model from Ollama. Please check the Ollama server logs for more details.

init.title: Queen's Guard Options
init.description: Options are managed via the reconfigure flow.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Queen's Guard
reconfigure.description:
